settings.heading: Stock the brands parents ask for
settings.text: Coolkidz supplies independent baby stores, national chains and online retailers across Australia, with the stock, training and marketing to help you sell.

settings.heading: What retailers can expect
settings.text: A partner that helps you sell, not just a supplier.

settings.title: A dedicated sales team
settings.text: Account management from people who know the brands and your store.

settings.title: Product training
settings.text: In-store training and product education, so your team sells with confidence.

settings.title: Merchandising advice
settings.text: Help getting the range and the floor right for your customers.

settings.title: Reliable stock
settings.text: A 7,000 sqm warehouse and national logistics to keep shelves full.

settings.title: Marketing support
settings.text: Campaigns, social and events that send parents looking for our brands.

settings.title: After-sales care
settings.text: Warranty and product support for your customers through our help desk.

settings.heading: The range
settings.text: Twelve brands across prams, nursery, sleep, feeding and care.

settings.name: UPPAbaby
settings.story: Prams, capsules and nursery pieces designed around how families actually live. Distributed, warranted and serviced in Australia by Coolkidz.

settings.name: Nanit
settings.story: Overhead HD baby monitors with sleep tracking, plus breathing motion monitoring through the night, all in the Nanit app.

settings.name: Gaia Baby
settings.story: Cots, dressers and nursing chairs like the Eos range, made to grow with your child from the first night.

settings.name: WonderFold
settings.story: Stroller wagons that seat two to six children, from the W2 to the W6, with room for everything else too.

settings.name: Magic
settings.story: Odour-free nappy bins with a twist-and-seal system and no refill cartridges.

settings.name: Frida
settings.story: Practical care for babies and new mums, from the NoseFrida to the hospital birth kit.

settings.name: ZAZU
settings.story: Sleep trainer clocks, nightlights, projectors and white noise for babies and toddlers.

settings.name: MiaMily
settings.story: Carry-on and check-in suitcases with a built-in seat, so little ones can ride through the airport.

settings.name: smarTrike
settings.story: The Wonder range of folding stroller-trikes, plus scooters that grow with your child.

settings.name: Mamave
settings.story: Gentle skincare for mum and baby, from Mumma's Oil to Bubba's Wash.

settings.name: Matchstick Monkey
settings.story: Teething toys and first toothbrushes shaped for small hands and sore gums.

settings.name: Hannie
settings.story: A portable high chair that packs down to go wherever you eat.

settings.heading: How to open an account
settings.text: Four steps from enquiry to first order.

settings.title: Apply
settings.text: Tell us about your store with the stockist form.

settings.title: We call
settings.text: A member of our sales team gets in touch to talk range and terms.

settings.title: Account set up
settings.text: We open your trade account and share catalogues and pricing.

settings.title: First order
settings.text: Stock ships from our warehouse, with training and point of sale to follow.

settings.heading: Apply to stock our brands
settings.text: Tell us about your store and a member of our sales team will be in touch.
